items.title: AMD, Broadcom stocks sink on tighter US chip rules, CoreWeave and Nebius shares drop
items.summary: Chip and AI infrastructure stocks moved lower as the US moved to restrict semiconductor exports to China in the wake of Nvidia's CEO scandal.

items.title: Intel’s 45% Downturn Over 3 Months Unsettles Investors: This Wall Street Analyst Predicts 155% Gains Anyway
items.summary: Intel just posted its best server quarter in 15 years, yet the stock cratered anyway. One analyst still sees a path to more than double from here, while others see a turnaround with no committed customers. Who is reading the data right?

items.title: Billionaire David Tepper Dumps AMD Stock, Makes $172 Million Bet on Oracle
items.summary: The investment firm expanded positions in SpaceX, Micron and Lam Research while reducing its holdings in Alphabet and Amazon.

items.title: Billionaire David Tepper Dumps AMD and Broadcom, Loads Up on Oracle and Nvidia
items.summary: David Tepper Doubles Down on Nvidia and SpaceX as Appaloosa Makes a Major Bet on Oracle

items.title: JPMorgan Global Select Equity ETF (JGLO) Sells $32.1 Million of Amazon on Nov. 13
items.summary: The fund traded $182.1 million of stock in Friday's session, decreasing 40 positions and increasing just one.

items.title: Own Qualcomm? Your Stock Rides On Data Center Now
items.summary: Our Monday look, If Phone Sales Keep Shrinking, What Happens To Your Qualcomm Stock?, asked what a weaker phone market means for owners. The next question is the one owners really care about: what is the biggest risk now.

items.title: Risky Nvidia Is Cheaper Than 'Safe' Walmart
items.summary: Everyone knows the cast: Nvidia is the AI growth stock, and Walmart and Costco are the safe places to hide. Nvidia reports today, Tuesday, Nov 17, with its results call set for 2 p.m. Going in, the labels have swapped on one count that matters: price against next year's earnings.

items.title: US Stock Futures Edge Lower After Tech Sell-Off — NVDA Earnings, AMD, SPCX, DIS In Focus
items.summary: Oil prices slipped and then recovered as recovering Middle East exports and expectations of a global supply surplus outweighed concerns over tanker attacks.
